linkCopied: Link copied. Share it with trusted minions only.
unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.body: You have changes that haven't been saved. If you leave now, they vanish like a hero's sidekick in act two. Save them first, or leave and pretend this never happened.
noResults: Nothing matches. Even our spies came back empty-handed.
itemArchived: {{name}} archived. The heroes will never find it now.
restoreHelp: Restored items return exactly where they were, with their minions, deadlines and comments intact. Anything that depended on them while they were archived will need to be reconnected by hand, so check your schemes afterwards.
comingSoon: This feature is coming soon. The engineers are still in the volcano, arguing about whether lasers count as lighting. We'll let you know as soon as it's ready, probably by carrier pigeon.
